svg.title: The Merkle tree of seven entries
svg.desc: Seven entries d0 to d6. Each leaf hash is SHA-256 of 0x00 followed by the entry: a to f, and j for d6. Each inner node is SHA-256 of 0x01, the left child and the right child: g, h, i, then k and l, then the root. The tree splits at the largest power of two below the size: 7 splits into 4 and 3.

text.tspan: split n at the largest power of two below it: 7 = 4 + 3, then 4 = 2 + 2, 3 = 2 + 1
